test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article for ₹460, Sudha loses 8%. If she sells it for ₹590, then her profit percentage is :
solution:
**Given:**

The first SP of the article = Rs. 460

Loss = 8%

The second SP = Rs. 590

**Formula used:**

CP = SP × 100/(100 - L%)

P% = P × 100/CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP = 460 × 100/(100 - 8)

⇒ 460 × 100/92 = 460 × 50/46 = 500

⇒ CP = Rs. 500

When SP = Rs. 590

⇒ Profit = 590 - 500 = 90

⇒ Profit % = 90 × 100/500 = 18

**Hence profit will be 18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** When loss is 8% SP is Rs. 460

⇒ 460 = 92%

⇒ 1 = 1/5

⇒ 590 = (1/5)590 = 118

⇒ SP is 118% of CP

**∴ Profit is 18%**
